tasks.short: Receive starting signals and drive locomotives

steps.what: Receive starting signals and operate locomotive controls for the journey

tasks.design: Retain the driver's signal recognition and control of the locomotive. A duty shown in {OTHER}, the rail duty system, does not authorise movement.
tasks.previous_blocker: Movement depends on live signals and operating conditions.
tasks.enabler_now: Crew allocation software supplies duties, not a replacement for driving.
tasks.still_hard: Responding correctly to changing conditions and ambiguous signals.
tasks.human_edge: Maintain attention and control throughout the journey.
tasks.altitude: Driving time and authority remain unchanged.

evidence.claim: SISCOG CREWS assigns daily work to drivers and guards; that capability does not establish automated train driving.

assumptions: Boundary is the driver's live movement task, excluding roster preparation and incident reports.
The conductor produces the live starting signal and the driver checks it during s1; conductor work is unchanged outside the focal boundary. No free structured permission flag is assumed.
Review existing cab and duty systems before considering additional software; none is proposed.
Zero upkeep because this design changes no system or operating process.
unknowns: Rolling stock, signal methods and operating procedures
research_questions: Which departure ambiguities require clarification under existing procedures?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100 gross0 upkeep0 net0; the complete driving task remains.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Monitor gauges for speed, amperage, battery charge and brake pressure

tasks.design: Retain active monitoring of installed cab instruments. Logging readings in {OTHER}, the train data system, earns no saving in the driver's monitoring time.
tasks.previous_blocker: Recorded measurements do not replace attention to operational meaning.
tasks.enabler_now: No supplied evidence establishes a change to the monitoring duty.
tasks.human_edge: Relate readings to the train's behaviour and conditions.
tasks.altitude: Monitoring time and responsibility stay unchanged.

evidence.claim: Cab monitoring remains a situated operating duty; automatic measurement alone does not establish labour savings.

assumptions: Boundary is observing and interpreting instruments, not maintenance or log transcription.
Installed instruments produce readings; the driver observes them during s1. No new sensor feed or automated safety classification is assumed.
Assess existing cab functionality before custom software; no change is proposed.
Zero upkeep because instruments and monitoring practice remain unchanged.
research_questions: Which anomalies are poorly represented by current instruments?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100 net0 with zero upkeep; live monitoring remains even when instruments record values.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Interpret train orders and operating rules

steps.what: Interpret train orders, signals and operating rules in the current situation

tasks.design: Keep operational interpretation with the qualified driver. An approved rulebook in {DOCS} remains a reference; this proposal adds no generated instruction to live operations.
tasks.previous_blocker: Written rules must be applied to a changing physical situation.
tasks.enabler_now: Document retrieval does not establish valid interpretation of live signals.
tasks.still_hard: Resolving conflicting or unclear information through operating procedures.
tasks.human_edge: Recognise uncertainty and seek clarification before acting.
tasks.altitude: Interpretation and operating responsibility stay unchanged.

evidence.claim: Operational interpretation is context-dependent and no driver time reduction is established here.

assumptions: Boundary is live interpretation, excluding document publication and roster planning.

Authorised control staff issue orders, infrastructure provides signals, and the rule owner publishes rules; the driver checks meaning and relevance during s1. Producer work is unchanged and earns no saving.
Use existing approved references before considering a custom answer tool; none is proposed.
Zero upkeep because no new tool or procedure is introduced.
research_questions: Which instruction conflicts require explicit clarification?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100 gross0 upkeep0 net0; live interpretation remains throughout.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Observe tracks and detect obstructions in the train's path

tasks.design: Keep continuous track observation with the driver. Existing incident information in {OTHER}, the rail operations system, does not establish that the visible route is clear.
tasks.previous_blocker: Obstructions can arise between reports and train arrival.
tasks.enabler_now: No supplied capability replaces the driver's lookout.
tasks.still_hard: Recognising hazards under limited visibility and short response times.
tasks.altitude: Lookout time and responsibility remain unchanged.

reach.learn: Precise location and observed hazard descriptions

evidence.claim: Track lookout is direct observation; a clear-route flag is not established by the digest.

assumptions: Boundary is the driver's lookout, excluding separate reporting or maintenance tasks.
The driver produces hazard observations during s1; no free structured obstruction feed or clear-route classification is assumed.
Consider existing installed systems before new tooling; none is proposed.
Zero upkeep because the operating method remains unchanged.
research_questions: Which visibility conditions challenge current lookout procedures?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100 gross0 upkeep0 net0; the complete lookout duty remains.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: These live operating tasks remain unchanged.
reach: Coordinate clear instructions and hazard descriptions with control staff
role.ambitious_version: A driver supported by clear information while retaining full operational responsibility.
